... Applicant
 
  versus
 
  State of Chhattisgarh Through Police Station -Bhatapara (Gramin), District
 Baloda Bazar Bhatapara Chhattisgarh.
---- Respondent 10.02.2025 Mr. M.K. Sinha, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Karan Bahrani, PL for the State.
Heard on I. A No. 02/2025, an application for grant of temporary Bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 279/2024, registered at Police Station -Bhatapara (Gramin),
District Baloda Bazar Bhatapara, (C.G), for the offence under Sections 450, 506, 376(3) of IPC and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text:
Police Station -Bhatapara (Gramin),
District Baloda Bazar Bhatapara
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that marriage of the applicant's sister to be performed on 14.02.2025, for which the applicant is required to present there and make arrangement for the marriage, hence, he prays for grant of temporary bail for this purpose.

In support of his contention,
he annexed the marriage card as Annexure A-4.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.
I have heard the learned counsel for the parties.
On due consideration the temporary bail application is allowed.

It is directed that after verification of the fact of marriage by the SHO of the concerned Police Station, applicant shall be released from the custody on 13.02.2025 upon furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.10,000/-
with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.
Applicant shall be required to surrender before the concerned Court on 18.02.2025.

List this case on 24.02.2025.
CC as per rules.
